notes: «حدثنا معلى، وموسى، قالا حدثنا وهيب» : two co-transmitters of one level
«وقال» with no speaker is the saying, relayed by Ayyub; the Prophet is not a link
«حدثنا قتيبة ... عن أيوب، مثله» is a second isnad of the same saying (مثله), so it is another group; no route is written for the saying's wording
